cells.code:
total = 0
count = 0
for row in scores:
    total += sum(row)
    count += len(row)
print("전체 합계:", total)
print("칸 수:", count)
print(f"평균: {total / count:.1f}")
cells.title: 표 전체 합계는 행 합계를 차례로 쌓아요

cells.code:
menu = ["coffee", "latte", "cake"]
sales = [[12, 8, 5],
         [10, 9, 7],
         [15, 11, 4]]
for row in sales:
    print(row, "하루 합계:", sum(row))
col = menu.index("latte")
latte = []
for row in sales:
    latte.append(row[col])
print("latte:", latte, "합계:", sum(latte))
